title: Cursor header
description: A flat 52px top bar in the page's paper colour that stays on top for the whole scroll: a bold wordmark at the left, five plain nav links centred on the page, and at the right a text sign-in, a hairline outline pill and an ink pill. Links fade to 75% ink on hover. On phones: wordmark, sign-in and a three-line menu button that drops the links down in a panel (no JavaScript).
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it stays for the whole scroll
the phone menu is a <details> disclosure, so it works without hydration
name: cursor-header
